purpose: Separate species-level nutrition for peppermint and spearmint without changing the genus-level mint master or its verdict.

publication.structural_reason: Separate public plant pages require rows in data/public_assessments.json, a verdict code in public_verdict.py/verdict-core.js and evidence records naming the plants; those files belong to the separate feeding-safety review and were not modified.

replaces_display_of: data/usda_mint_variety_candidates_20261009.json (same FDC records; the candidate file is kept as history and no longer rendered, so each FDC record is shown once)

rda_peppermint_record.independence: not independent: water, protein, fat, carbohydrate, fibre, Ca, P, K, Na, Fe and vitamin C equal USDA FDC 173474; vitamin A differs (RDA 0 vs USDA 212 µg RAE) and RDA states refuse 39%

species.not_same_as: 식약처 #774 ‘박하’(Mentha arvensis var. piperascens; GBIF에서 Mentha canadensis L.의 이명)는 영문 별칭이 Peppermint이지만 다른 종이다.
